caseno: Civil Revision No. 6025 of 1991 (Dhaka) and Civil Revision No. 256 of 1986 (Jessore)
lawyer: Md. Abdur Rahim, Advocate ----- For the Petitioners.
parties:
Abul Hossain Molla and another ----- Petitioner
Vs. 
Khoteza Nessa Bibi and others ----- Opposite Party
full_judgment: 10. Mr. Rahim submits that the Judgment of the Appellate Court below is not a proper Judgment of reversal and also not proper Judgment of the Appellate Court itself. The Lower Appellate Court has neither discussed the evidence of the PWs nor the DWs. In a short-cut manner he just approved the Judgment and decree of the trial Court, I have found above that the Judgment of the lower Appellate Court cannot be sustained in law as it discharged its onus only by writing a few sentences. This deed of gift was registered on 16.1.71 and the suit was filed on 20.3.82. PW 2 said that about 10 years back that is in 1975 he came to know about this deed of gift. PWs 2 and 3 also stated that they found the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 possessing part of the suit land. On this point Mr. Rahim submits that the present suit is absolutely barred by limitation. Although it was not specifically urged in the Court below yet Mr. Rahim submits from oral evidence on record that the suit is barred by limitation. He submits that limitation will run either under article 91 or Article 120 of the Limitation Act. Since the evidence of the plaintiff's shows that by the year 1975 PW 2 came to know about the sale deed the suit for cancellation of the same was filed on 20.3.84 and. as such. it is hit under Article 120 of the Limitation Act. I find force in the above contention of Mr. Rahim.
